answer: Credit is granted only against settled payments from unrelated principals: each identity builds a borrowing limit equal to a fraction of its verified external revenue, like a harbor that deepens only with real tides. Payments circulating inside one cluster add nothing, so a raven circling its own nest earns no credit. An honest agent serving real clients gains liquidity by working, while a sybil farmer must fund every fake trade with outside money and finds no haven where looped payments create leverage.
